Concretely: drive the verify-forward hidden state of the deepest committed spine node (this boot: node_id 5, flat committed_row 5, capture forward-row 4, best_path [0,1,3,5,8] — NOT "node 7") to within-floor of a clean teacher-forced forward, starting from L0 GDN where the first nonzero appears (max_abs 0.0078 on a byte-exact input) and through the deep full-attn amplifiers L59/L63. APPROACH: (a) Do NOT re-apply "Route 1 / route full-attn through the FA2-fork additive-inf tree-bias path" as the primary fix — it is ALREADY ON in this boot (FR13_FA2_TREE_BIAS=1 default, confirmed passed into the container, attention-backend TREE_ATTN) and the flip occurred WITH it active; the FA2-fork floor doc already proves that op byte-exact to max 0.0039 (15x below the 0.059 floor) vs the native-on-path oracle, so the deep full-attn OP is not the un-bit-exact carrier. (b) The artifacts localize the seed to a DIFFUSE L0-onward GDN fp accumulation (R-correct, cos>0.995/layer) that the deep full-attn layers AMPLIFY directionally (rel divergence 0.09->0.28 at L59, cos 0.996->0.971; L63 max_abs 30) — i.e. Route 2 territory: make the deep-row GDN-scan reductions N/co-residency-independent (#42960 class) and/or batch-invariant the deep full-attn GEMMs to kill the seed, then re-ladder. (c) DECISIVE missing test the follow-up MUST run: the SUBSTITUTION test the ladder skipped — splice the clean-prefill L59-L63 full-attn outputs (or the clean L0-L58 hidden) into the verify forward and re-forward to lm-head to causally confirm whether the deep full-attn amplification (vs the diffuse L0-L58 seed) is what actually flips the 0.5-nat argmax; the current "dominant carrier" claim is correlational only. (d) Also compare the verify deepest-spine row against the FA2-fork PER-PATH oracle (the floor-doc methodology), not only against a different clean prefill, to separate op-divergence from input-drift.
ladderVerify.issues:
VERDICT: holds=false — the localization (claims 1,2,4) is solid, but the ROOT-OP attribution (claim 3) is overstated/correlational and the RECOMMENDED FIX (claim 6) is materially wrong (it describes a config already active in the very boot that produced the flip). Engagement (5) has one unbacked gate.

(1) RIGHT ROW / RIGHT SERVE-EVENT — HOLDS, with a labeling correction. Cross-checked via FR13_COMMIT_ARGMAX_GATE (529 records): the analyzed capture forward-row 4 maps to the gate's committed_row 5 = the row that SERVED the flipped token 1970 (' code') at served-stream pos 21 (served_p2.json[21]=1970), with exact triple-match argmax=1970/runnerup=3425/margin=0.5. Verified by step-8 commit reconstruction: best_path [0,1,3,5,8], rows 0/1/3/5/8 -> served[18..23] = 23748,279,9468,1970,9444,303; the 1970 commit is node_id 5 / committed_row 5. BUT this is node 5 on best_path [0,1,3,5,8] (deepest spine node, depth-4), NOT 'node 7'. The 'node 7' name (and the [0,1,3,5,7] framing) is a carried-over misnomer; the physical row analyzed is correct, the name is wrong throughout the result.

(2) FIRST-DIVERGENT LAYER — HOLDS. Independently recomputed from raw call6 (verify, forward-row 4) vs call33 (clean, row 849): input_hidden byte-exact (max_abs 0.0, nonzero 0, both norm 1.0692, identical first-5 floats), embeddings non-trivial, MRoPE position 849 aligned, input token served[20]=9468 confirmed. First nonzero = L0 linear_attention (GDN) max_abs 0.0078 / 4353 nonzero channels; no earlier nonzero swept (threshold was literally 0.0). Full 64-layer ladder reproduced exactly (cos>0.995 through L58; L59 cos 0.996->0.971; L63 max_abs 1.69->30.0). The byte-exact input makes this the strongest part of the result.

(3) CAUSATION — PARTIALLY HOLDS / OVERSTATED. The magnitude+propagation argument is sound directionally: relative divergence ||delta||/||h|| stays ~0.07-0.10 through L58 then jumps to 0.28 at L59 (full_attn) and 0.30 at L63; the deep full-attn layers ARE the dominant amplifiers. BUT (i) no substitution test was run (admitted), so 'the L0-L58 drift would NOT flip a 0.5-nat margin' is asserted, not proven — a 9% relative perturbation on a 122-norm final hidden (cos 0.987) could plausibly move a 0.5-nat logit gap on its own; the conclusion is correlational. (ii) The op attribution conflicts with the FA2-fork floor evidence (see 6).

(4) CLEAN REFERENCE — HOLDS. clean_argmax 3425 (' files') is the max_tokens=1 RETURNED token_id (run_ladder.py L136-137 reads choices.token_ids[0], NOT the off-by-one streamed logprob), runner-up ' code' 1970 at -1.91 nat. Clean prefill routes through FA2_PREFILL_NATIVE (non-tree); input byte-exact to the verify row. Structured says clean == native E5 (not re-derivable from these artifacts but consistent).

(5) ENGAGEMENT — MOSTLY HOLDS, ONE GAP. TREE_ATTN op fired (tree_attn_bias (10,10), query/output (10,24,256) at layer 3 = confirms 10-row verify forward; 12 op files). node7 hidden/logit captures non-vacuous (141/138 files, num_tokens seen [10]). Gate armed (529 records, both flips present). Flags correct (ATTENTION_BACKEND=TREE_ATTN, FR13_FA2_TREE_BIAS=1, FR13_FA2_PREFILL_NATIVE=1, C0 all-FIX-ON, ENFORCE_EAGER). FLASH_ATTN op 0 captures correctly explained (clean routes via FA2-native, not the FLASH hook). Both served flips reproduced (p2 pos21=1970, p3 pos73=9764 'Let'). GAP: det_gate.json does NOT exist anywhere on disk — the within-boot determinism PASS '[True,True,True,True]' (class 8, the FIRST gate of any campaign) is NOT backed by a persisted artifact; only indirectly corroborated by served-stream reproduction. Minor: reduce.py's GATE_MARGIN p3=7.25 disambiguation is inert/mismatched (the analyzed p3 event has margin 0.125 with runnerup 71093='```'; the gate's margin-7.25 p3 event has runnerup 44780, a different decision context) — the reduce still picked the correct clean-comparable event, so non-material, but the 7.25 label in the result is wrong for the analyzed p3 event.

(6) RECOMMENDED FIX — DOES NOT HOLD (material failure). Route 1 ('route all 16 verify full-attn layers through the FA2-fork additive-inf tree-bias path, ~0 speed cost, removes the L59/L63 amplifier') is ALREADY THE ACTIVE CONFIG in this exact boot: FR13_FA2_TREE_BIAS=1 is the launcher default and is confirmed passed into the container (scripts/fr13_launch_forked_fa2_tree_server.sh L15-16,257-258), with attention-backend TREE_ATTN. The flip occurred WITH the fork bias on. The FA2-fork floor doc (project_fr13_fa2_fork_nocopy_floor) proves that path is byte-exact vs the native-on-path oracle to max 0.0039 over ~983k comparisons (15x below the 0.059 E5 floor), i.e. the deep full-attn OP is NOT the un-bit-exact carrier. The ladder's L59/L63 'amplifier' is the already-bit-exact attention op amplifying the DIFFUSE GDN-from-L0 input drift — and the ladder measured this against a DIFFERENT clean prefill (different KV/row layout), not the per-path oracle the floor used, so it cannot distinguish op-divergence from input-drift. Therefore the named fix cannot remove the flip (it's already applied), and the root-op attribution to 'TREE_ATTN full-attn op' is inconsistent with the project's own floor evidence. The artifacts actually localize the lever to the diffuse L0-onward GDN/deep-GEMM fp accumulation seed (Route 2), plus the un-run substitution test to causally confirm carrier.
